EXTRAORDINARY
LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT)
ACT, No. 28 OF 1964 (CHAPTER 460) Notice under Section 7
Land Ministry Ref. No.: J/78/LG/395.
My No.: ඉඅ/5/332.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of Land Acquisition Act, No. 28 of 1964 (Amendment) that the Government intends to acquire the following land which is required for a public purpose:-

Description of the land to be acquired: Fifteen (15) allotments of land in Total Extent of about 0.135 Hectare depicted in P.P.G. 2126 prepared by the Surveyor General Situated in the Village of Hikkaduwa, No. 02, Wellawattha and No. 03, Wellabada Hikkaduwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Hikkaduwa in Galle District, Southern Province, morefully described below:
01. Lot No. 01 Name of land: Wella Addara Maha Wattha; Description: Garden, Contains 1 Coconut tree 20 years Old; Claimant: Peeter Alwis; Extent: 0.004 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 02 Name of land: Kurunduwattha; Description: Open Waste land; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.003 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 03 Name of land: Wella Addara Mahawattha and Maradane Koggalawattha; Description: Waste land; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.001 Hectare.
04. Lot No. 04 Name of land: Maradane Koggala Wattha; Description: Open Waste land; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.004 Hectare.
05. Lot No. 05 Name of land: Maradane Koggala Wattha; Description: Garden, Contains 1 Coconut tree 30 Years Old; Claimant: Elan Kathrina, Kurunduwattha; Extent: 0.006 Hectare.
06. Lot No. 06 Name of land: Maradane Koggala Wattha and Ambagahawattha; Description: Open Waste land; Claimant: State; Extent: 0.004 Hectare.
07. Lot No. 07 Name of land: Maradane Koggala Wattha and Ambagahawattha; Description: Open Waste land; Claimant: M. W. Senewirathne, Kurunduwattha, Hikkaduwa; Extent: 0.006 Hectare.
08. Lot No. 08 Name of land: Ambagaha Maradane Wattha; Description: Open Waste land; Claimant: P. Panditharathne, Kurunduwattha, Hikkaduwa; Extent: 0.006 Hectare.

THE LAND ACQUISITION (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: LAN/ACQU/POLKA/D31/03.
Land Ministry No.: 4-3/4/2015/LO/187.

I, hereby give notice, under section (1) of Section 7 of the Land section 7 of the land Acquisition Act as Amended by the land acquisition (Amendment) Act., No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire following land/Servitude which is required for a public purpose.

Description of the land or servitude to be acquired: Under mention Land is situated Pattiyadichenai Village Kaldudah 204 Grama Niladhari Division in Koralaipattu Divisional Secretariat Batticaloa in Eastern Province and Preliminary plan was prepared by Survey General details in PP/මඩ/2811 and extended 2.9078.
Lot No. 1 — Name of land: Pachaimadukadu and Muthiyanmadukkadu; Usage at Present: High land Corps; Claimant: Natkunam Wimalendran; Extent: 2.9078 Hectares.
North: Road (R.D.A.); East: Road (R.D.A.) TPs 169428 and 304539; South: 304539; West: TPs 304539 and 169428.

All Person interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which aservitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in Writing, before at Koralaipattu Divisional Secretariat on 26.09.2016 at 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 12.09.2016 the nature of their interest in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquision of said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
V. VASUTHEVAN, Divisional Secretary, Koralaipattu. Divisional Secretary’s Office, Koralaipattu. 09 - 77
